subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close or replace the open conflicting fork PR before allowing a fresh narrow fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is clear and narrow, but the issue is currently linked to an open fork PR that is not a viable landing path; automation should not open a competing fix until maintainers decide how to handle that paired PR.

options.title: Replace the fork candidate
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh narrow fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt it manually
options.body: A maintainer can manually port the useful idea from the fork into the active runtime and take ownership of proof and review.

options.title: Keep waiting on the fork
options.body: Leave the issue paired to the open fork PR, accepting that ClawSweeper should not queue a competing fix while that candidate remains open.

recommendation.title: Replace the fork candidate
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh narrow fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the native approval lifecycle refactor and are the clearest history owner for the active runtime boundary.
